svg.title: SahaRez — Offline-first booking platform for football pitches.
svg.desc: Role-based flows for pitch owners and players. Room cache keeps the app usable without a network. Waiting lists with instant booking confirmation. Match ads to find opponents and rent equipment. Stack: Kotlin, MVVM, Room, Retrofit, Coroutines, PHP, MySQL. Architecture: View → ViewModel → Repository, which reads from a Room cache and a Retrofit client calling a PHP REST API backed by MySQL.
svg.text: Offline-first booking platform for football pitches.
